source.title_or_context: LCSD is indicated in patients with symptomatic g LQTS when: (a) ICD therapy is contraindicated or declined; (b) patient is on beta-blockers and genotype-specific therapies with an ICD and experiences multiple shocks or syncope due to VA. I C Invasive electrophysiologic study is not recommended in LQTS. III C Recommendations for management of patients with Andersen–Tawil syndrome Genetic testing is recommended in patients with suspected Andersen–Tawil syndrome. I C ICD implantation is recommended

table_assessment.assessment_notes: Exact review confirms a composite 23-row table spanning multiple inherited arrhythmia syndromes and mixing diagnostic, testing, avoidance, medication, and procedural recommendations. Repeated recommendations require duplicate control and human adjudication.
